mountain.name: Story mountain
mountain.intro: A story mountain has five parts. The story climbs up to the big problem, then comes down.

parts.t: Meet the character and the place. Show what a normal day is like.
Something starts to happen. Small problems begin and the story climbs.
The top of the mountain. The biggest problem or scariest moment. The character must choose what to do.
The character solves the problem or learns something.
Show how things are now. How does the character feel?

mountain.fit: Hooks usually sit in the build-up, before the problem. Links come at the problem and when it is solved.

arc.name: 8-point story arc
arc.intro: The 8-point arc has eight steps. The character wants something, makes a hard choice, and changes.

parts.t: A normal day. Nothing has changed yet.
Something happens that stops the normal day and starts the story.
The character goes after a goal. Small problems get in the way.
Something unexpected happens. Now it is harder.
A hard choice. What the character picks shows what matters to them.
The biggest, most exciting moment of the story.
What happens because of the climax. Something changes for good.
A new normal. The character and the world are different now.

arc.fit: Hooks usually sit between the trigger and the surprise. Links come at the critical choice, the climax and the reversal.

practice.title: Mei and the Red Hat
mountain: Mei walks to school on a calm morning in her new red hat.
A strong wind lifts the hat off her head and it floats away.
The hat lands on a high branch. Mei cannot reach it.
Mei asks the caretaker for help and he fetches a ladder.
Mei smiles and holds her hat tight all the way to class.
arc: Mei walks to school on a calm morning in her new red hat.
A strong wind lifts the hat off her head.
Mei chases the hat down the road, past the shops.
The hat lands on a high branch, far out of reach.
Mei must choose: climb the tree alone or ask a grown-up for help.
She asks the caretaker and he holds the ladder while she reaches up.
Mei grabs the hat and learns that asking for help is brave.
Mei wears her hat tight, and now she knows she can ask for help.

practice.title: Sam's Sports Day
mountain: Sam wakes up excited for Sports Day at his school.
At the start line, his shoelace comes undone.
Halfway round the track, Sam trips and falls.
Sam gets up, ties his lace and keeps running.
Sam finishes last but proud, and his friends cheer.
arc: Sam wakes up excited for Sports Day at his school.
At the start line, his shoelace comes undone.
He ties it fast and runs hard to catch up with the others.
Halfway round, a girl drops her water bottle right in front of him.
Sam must choose: stop to help or keep running to win.
He stops, picks up the bottle and hands it back to her.
Sam finishes last, but she thanks him and the crowd cheers.
Sam goes home proud. He knows kindness matters more than a medal.
